changelog:
**Expanded and clarified API docs with new template contract and updated auth/error details:**

- Overhauled authentication and error code explanations, adding details on how API keys and subscription status are checked.
- Updated template contract: templates are now defined by a single code (JSX/TSX) field; legacy fields like jsx/variables/googleFonts are rejected.
- Expanded image minting endpoint (`/v1/url`) to include new options (`devicePixelRatio`), clearer field constraints, and longer URL expiry.
- Documented that public image requests 301 redirect to Cloudflare Worker; clarified query params and opaqueness of signed URLs.
- Updated AI template generation: always uses batch format, lists all error responses, and item-by-item status in responses.
- Added structured tables for all field types, constraints, and error codes for easier reference.
summary: Use when the user wants to call, test, or integrate the HTMLPix HTML-to-image API — including auth setup, signed URL minting, image rendering, template CRUD,...
